description: source_offset is the window origin into the shot's internal timeline: a child at internal time tau appears at start - offset + tau and is visible only inside [start, start + duration]. Shot A|B|C|D is trimmed at its start edge from 10 s to 12 s (offset 2 s, duration 6 s, end fixed at 18 s). Stored heads spell source_offset as {start, end} in ms; 'start' is the origin and 'end' is legacy and never read. Survey 18 Nov 2026: 0 heads and 0 revisions in the stack copy (17 heads, 54 revisions) and the live realm (7 heads, 9 revisions) hold a nonzero offset, so redefining the projections changes no existing head. Consumers (Agent projection, Runtime visual_seam, Runtime timeline_inspection, App) must reproduce `expected` from `occurrence` and `clips`; times in seconds.
